meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 它给 agent 装上 mnemon 的图结构持久记忆：回复前自动调出相关旧上下文，每轮对话后把新见解存下来。记忆写入该 agent 组的 .claude/ 挂载，容器重启后仍在。
howto.when: 当你把这个技能应用到运行默认 Claude provider 的 agent 组时启用；组里 provider 设为 opencode 等其它值时，注册的 hooks 不会运行。

say.text: 给我这个 agent 装上 mnemon 持久记忆
检查 mnemon 是不是已经装在这个项目里
确认 mnemon 的 hooks 已经在容器里注册

howto.what_en: Adds mnemon graph-based persistent memory to an agent: it recalls relevant past context before replying and stores new insights after each turn. Memory lives in the agent group's .claude/ mount and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Use it on agent groups running the default Claude provider (container.json provider absent or "claude"). Groups with another provider, e.g. opencode, never run the registered hooks.

say_en.text: Install mnemon persistent memory for this agent
say_en.note: Edits the Dockerfile and entrypoint, then rebuilds the image

say_en.text: Check whether mnemon is already applied in this project
Confirm the mnemon hooks are registered in the container
say_en.note: Inspects settings.json inside the running container
